bio: The Francis Hotel is located right in the heart of the Bath city centre, on the edge of the prestigious Queen Square.  Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea menu including smoked salmon and coronation chicken sandwiches, cakes and jumbo scones with lashings of clotted cream and jam.  Compliment your Afternoon Tea with your choice of hot drink; coffee, tea or hot chocolate, or treat yourself to a glass of bubbly or one of the original and unique Bridgerton cocktails, named after characters from the show. Gluten free, vegetarian and vegan options are also available (please specify dietary requirements in advance).  The comfortable Emily’s Tea Lounge and Bar No.10 are perfect places to sit back and watch the rest of Bath walk by. Dogs are also welcome to sit with you during your Afternoon Tea.
